name: GetKpiByCustomer
description: Get KPI metrics per customer from SAP: revenue, order count, average order value, fulfillment rate. Trigger when user asks about customer performance, top customers by revenue, client-level sales analysis, or specific customer KPI. All params optional — call immediately on intent match.

customerIdOrName.description: Customer ID or partial name to filter to a specific customer (e.g. 'CUST-3001', 'Philly Bikes'). Null to return all customers ranked by revenue.

fromDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

toDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

salesOrg.description: Sales org filter. Null if not specified.

top.description: Return top N customers by revenue (1–50). Null if not specified.
